claim_tested: STA-2 retains a canonical STAT DNA-binding domain
key_finding: STA-2 FAILS Pfam PF02864 STAT-DBD HMM and STAT-DBD CDD; only hits weak fold superfamilies (IPR008967 p53-like TF DBD; IPR012345). STA-1, STAT1, Stat92E all pass PF02864.
confidence_limitations: High for HMM result; superfamily hit still indicates fold retained

citation: computed (1BF5 contact mapping + alignment, this study)
key_finding: STA-2 conserves 0/3 base-contacting residues (E421->S,S459->G,N460->P) and 3/16 of all DNA contacts; lowest DBD identity (20%). But STA-1 (DNA-binder) also 0/3 base, 4/16 — so residue divergence alone is non-discriminating.
context: PDB 1BF5 STAT1-DNA complex; BLOSUM62 global alignment
confidence_limitations: Medium; divergent-sequence alignment uncertainty at loops

claim_tested: STA-2 folds into the STAT DBD fold
key_finding: STA-2 DBD-region mean pLDDT 88.1 (90% >70), comparable to STA-1 DBD 81.4 and own SH2 95.0.
STA-2 DBD vs STAT1 1BF5 RMSD 8.22 A (126 CA) ~ STA-1 8.00 A (127 CA): no more divergent than DNA-binding control.
confidence_limitations: Crude rigid-body RMSD, no outlier trimming; comparative only

claim_tested: STA-2 has the canonical STAT activating tyrosine
key_finding: STAT1-Y701 conserved in STA-1 (Y588) but absent/gapped in STA-2 (truncated at 567 aa). Canonical sequence-specific GAS binding requires pY-driven dimerization.
context: global alignment STAT1 vs nematode STATs

context: C. elegans epidermis, D. coniospora infection
confidence_limitations: High for interaction; no direct DNA assay reported
